name: learning-hub
description: Monorepo entrypoint for the Learning Hub backend and frontend apps.
author: Serhii TK

scripts.build: npm run build:portal && npm run build:learner && npm run build:instructor && npm run build:admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:portal && npm run typecheck:learner && npm run typecheck:instructor && npm run typecheck:admin
scripts.backend:test: python scripts/run_backend_manage.py test Studentlist.tests apps.online.tests apps.training.tests
scripts.compose:config:all: npm run compose:config && npm run compose:config:infra && npm run compose:config:infra-tls && npm run compose:config:app
scripts.verify:local: npm run review:check && npm run backend:check && npm run backend:migrations:check && npm run backend:test && npm run build && npm run compose:config:all
